raw.query: WITH current_eda AS (SELECT m.* FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.eda_metric m ON m.run_id = d.run_id WHERE d.is_current = true), counts AS (SELECT substring(metric_path FROM '^context_tokens_by_numimages\.([0-9]+)\.count$')::bigint AS num_images, value_num::bigint AS requests FROM current_eda WHERE run_id = 'eda:a_quality' AND metric_path ~ '^context_tokens_by_numimages\.[0-9]+\.count$'), picked AS (SELECT max(value_num) FILTER (WHERE metric_path = 'numimages.share_text_only') AS text_only_share, max(CASE WHEN metric_path = 'numimages.all_perfect_squares' THEN value_bool::int END)::boolean AS all_perfect_squares, max(value_num) FILTER (WHERE metric_path = 'classes.frames.request_share') AS frames_request_share, max(value_num) FILTER (WHERE metric_path = 'classes.frames.image_share') AS frames_image_share FROM current_eda) SELECT p.text_only_share, p.all_perfect_squares, p.frames_request_share, p.frames_image_share, sum(c.requests) FILTER (WHERE c.num_images > 0 AND floor(sqrt(c.num_images::numeric))^2 <> c.num_images) AS nonsquare_image_bearing_requests, string_agg(c.num_images || ':' || c.requests, ', ' ORDER BY c.num_images) FILTER (WHERE c.num_images > 0 AND floor(sqrt(c.num_images::numeric))^2 <> c.num_images) AS nonsquare_breakdown FROM picked p CROSS JOIN counts c GROUP BY p.text_only_share, p.all_perfect_squares, p.frames_request_share, p.frames_image_share
